title_as_printed: Observations on the Chinantec Language of Mexico
author: Daniel G. Brinton
journal: Proceedings of the American Philosophical Society
place: San Pedro de Yolos (Yolox), Oaxaca, Mexico
collector: Nicolás de la Barreda (source); compiled by Daniel G. Brinton
about: Brinton compiled this vocabulary from a manuscript copy of Nicolás de la Barreda's Doctrina Christiana en Lengua Chinanteca (Mexico, 1730), written while Barreda was cura of San Pedro de Yolos.
